crossRefs.note: How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?
We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.
How long, Yahweh? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?
How long, Yahweh? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?
Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,
With which your enemies have mocked, Yahweh, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.
One said to the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, “How long will it be to the end of these…
They cried with a loud voice, saying, “How long, Master, the holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on…

translations.web: How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?
translations.bsb: How long, O God, will the enemy taunt You? Will the foe revile Your name forever?
translations.kjv: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?
translations.asv: How long, O God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?
